title: The energy manual · ET-SoC-1
description: What every kind of operation on the ET-SoC-1 costs in joules: the card at rest, an awake core, every instruction on zeros and random data, bytes at every level of memory and between shires, synchronisation, and how to build a workload's energy from the parts. Measured on three cards (aifoundry2, aifoundry3 and aifoundry1 card 1), with confidence bars from repeated passes; checked on all three on 26 September 2026.
